items.title: ScienceDaily: One tiny chemical difference between RNA and DNA may help explain how life began
items.content_text: Scientists may have found a clue to one of the biggest mysteries surrounding the origin of life: how fragile RNA molecules could gather and survive before cells existed. Remarkably, much of this behavior may come down to a single oxygen-containing chemical group that RNA has but DNA lacks.
